name: status_inflict
description: Status infliction and cleansing of one hit (the 25 regular statuses): chance against resistance, the Threaten roll, exclusive statuses, durations, Petrify and shatter, Haste and Slow with the CTB amount, immunity pop-ups and the result counters.

function.signature: uint inflict_status(int userId, Chr *user, int targetId, Chr *target, Cmd *cmd, int *applied, int *removed, Rec *rec, uint mask, int *damage, int *threatenFlag)

harness.note: the real machine code of the functions, only the RNG function replaced by a script; rngDraws is what the game asked for

notes: Arrays in in/out (chances, durations, resist, counters, applied, removed) are sparse: {"index": value}, every missing index is 0.
rngDraws are the user mode 2 stream draws the game made; userIsAeon picks stream 59 instead of 52 + id.
ctbDamageTouched is true when the game wrote the CTB amount (a Threaten landed, or a Haste or Slow failed and zeroed it).
Inputs were cleaned of fields the function does not read for the vector and re-run; the machine answer was checked equal to the uncleaned run.
Class edge_petrify_extra_word: Petrify landing on a party member and on a monster, against records whose extra word has Eject (bit 8), bit 15 and the bits the Petrify mask clears.
